description: Balanced public-safe messaging for general downstream communities and shared water-dependent sites.
corridor_template: communities and water-dependent sites connected to {region}
default_impact_copy: Operators should keep updates focused on untreated intake, public-service sites, and water-dependent livelihoods.

signal_rules.impact_copy: Cloudier water can affect untreated intake, storage systems, and raw exchange points quickly.
Oxygen stress can hit aquaculture sites and other water-dependent operations before households notice visible change.
Rapid water chemistry shifts can make untreated water harder to use safely for direct intake and food preparation.
